Welcome to the island

Every journey
is worth remembering.

Welcome to the Oxide: Survival Island encyclopedia. We organize items, weapons, armor, materials and survival tips to help every newcomer take their first steps.

You are not just finding answers.
You are learning to create your own survival story.
Explore

Start with a tree and a stone. Learn the island’s resources and discover surprises in unexplored places.

Create

Find recipes, craft tools and equipment, and turn your ideas into useful creations.

Together

Share discoveries and experience with friends. Working together turns ordinary adventures into lasting memories.

This player-made reference site helps you learn the game. The real adventure begins when you land on the island, make choices and overcome challenges. Set out with curiosity and return with your own story.
